title: Add Built‑in Request Validation Middleware
description: Introduce a lightweight validation layer that lets developers declare schemas for route parameters, query strings, headers, and bodies using a simple declarative API. It automatically rejects invalid requests with a 400 response, reducing boilerplate and preventing malformed data from reaching business logic.
testCases: Valid request passes through middleware and reaches the handler
Invalid JSON body returns 400 with detailed error message
Missing required query param returns 400 with field name
Extra unknown fields are ignored unless 'strict' mode is enabled
acceptance: All existing tests continue to pass; new validation tests pass; middleware can be attached per‑route via router.use('/path', validate({body: schema})) and returns 400 on any schema violation with a JSON error payload.
reason: Improves security and developer ergonomics by catching bad input early, lowers bug surface, and aligns yantraverse with modern API standards without adding external dependencies.
